#!/bin/bash
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> START <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com -o get-docker.sh
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> TWO <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
sudo sh get-docker.sh
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> THREE <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
sudo apt install --assume-yes docker-compose
echo ">>>>>>>>>>>>> FOUR <<<<<<<<<<<<<"
curl -o docker-compose.yml https://gist.githubusercontent.com/robzhu/a127a6bce1ea25b01d40efb57ad1c26e/raw/30a2927a901dd614a518319cfeaa63a6bd2648a4/gistfile1.txt; sed -i 's/YOURSERVERNAME/GIMBOIDIA/' docker-compose.yml; sed -i 's/ATLEAST5CHARACTERS/bucklemyshoe/' docker-compose.yml; sudo docker-compose up
